# B7/B8/B9 matrix and the runner takes them as a separate invocation, because
# the crossover statement the matrix tests centres Q4_K, Q5_K, and Q6_K and Q2_K
# must not enter it by implication.
# Q2_K leaves MMVQ at ne11 above 4 (mmvq.cu:298), so every B here is already
# past its own threshold. The artifact is four-family by byte -- Q2_K 38.35%,
# Q6_K at 8, so it steps at B8 and again at B9 for reasons that belong to types
# other than the one the file is named for. It is retained as the arm that shows
# what a mixed artifact does, not as a Q2_K measurement.
